note: Draft vectors for LIP-0023. No vector reads a node. Keys are the compressed forms of published BIP-340 test keys and belong to nobody. The octets of signatures are placeholders, and no signature in this file verifies. The group graphs states facts and holds no transaction. A vector whose outcome is not ok holds one defect and names a neighbour with the outcome ok that differs from it in that defect; a vector marked compound holds two defects and names none. No verdict of this file records a closure.

fields.inputs: spent_script_hex is the script of the output that the input spends; witness_hex lists the items of its witness in their order.
fields.graphs: t is the seal transaction and a the anchor. height and position are null for a pending transaction; position is the place of a transaction in its block. carries_witness is false for a transaction without a witness for any input. t.outputs names the kind of each output of t by its index; seal_vout is the index that the grant names. An input of a that has spends_output_of_t spends that output of t; every other input states parent_height, the height of the block that holds the transaction whose output it spends, or null where that transaction is pending. form is the result of C3.1 for the input, as the group inputs decides it. purpose is admission or construction: for construction a pending anchor is no refusal.
